name: Elopements
short: Just the two of you, a photographer, and somewhere unforgettable at first light.
summary: Just the two of you, a photographer and a place worth getting up for: the ramparts of Galle Fort at sunrise, a tea estate in the clouds, an empty beach.

image.alt: An avenue of palms running down to the coast

facts.detail: Plus a photographer and a celebrant

intro.heading: The wedding, without the guest list.
paragraphs: An elopement here usually sits inside a longer journey: a few days in the hill country, a morning that is yours alone, then the coast to finish.
We find the place and the hour, arrange the celebrant and the photographer, and make sure the rest of the trip feels like the honeymoon it is.

schedule.heading: How the day might go.
schedule.lede: One example. Yours will be built around the place you choose.

items.title: The walk up
items.body: A short drive and a walk to a tea-estate ridge or the fort ramparts, before anyone else is there.

items.title: The ceremony
items.body: Vows with a celebrant, two witnesses if it is a legal ceremony, and a photographer who knows when to step back.

items.title: Breakfast for two
items.body: Set somewhere private, with the photographs still to come and nowhere else to be.

items.title: The journey goes on
items.body: Your driver takes you on to the next stay, and the honeymoon starts that afternoon.

includes.heading: What we arrange.
includes.body: The few things that matter, done properly.

items.title: The place and the permission
items.body: Estates, forts and beaches that allow a ceremony, booked for the hour you want.

items.title: Celebrant or registrar
items.body: A symbolic ceremony, or the registrar, witnesses and paperwork for a legal one.

items.title: Photographer, flowers, hair and make-up
items.body: People we have worked with, briefed on the plan and the timing.

items.title: The journey around it
items.body: Stays and a private driver for the rest of the trip, written out day by day.

questions.a: For a legal ceremony, yes, and we can provide them. A symbolic ceremony needs none.

questions.q: Can we elope during a journey we have already booked with you?
questions.a: Yes. Tell us the date and the place you have in mind and we will build the morning into your route.
